verdict.rationale: The only retention-relevant control in the evidence is a global opt-out: setting OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1 stops trace collection to the Traces dashboard. The SDK also keeps conversation history in built-in session memory, but nothing describes clearing, deleting, or setting retention limits on that history or on uploaded traces. Missing for 10: documented session/history deletion APIs, configurable retention periods for traces and sessions, deletion of data already sent to the Traces dashboard, independent corroboration.
